description: Chest X-ray preprocessing for the TB model (TRD 9.3, 10.6; ADR-16). The app must reproduce these steps exactly; ml/train/preprocess.py is the reference implementation.
steps: decode the image and convert to 8-bit grayscale (PIL mode 'L', ITU-R 601-2 luma)
resize straight to input_size x input_size with bilinear resampling, ignoring the aspect ratio (no padding)
copy the grayscale channel to 3 channels
divide by 255, then subtract mean and divide by std per channel
why_no_padding: cxr-pre-1 kept the aspect ratio and padded to a square. In the Shenzhen set TB images are narrower than normal ones (aspect ratio alone gives AUROC 0.716), so the padding bars told the model the label. Stretching removes that cue (ADR-16).
